description: Compile ArchLang `.arch` source (or a Plan-JSON object) to an SVG floor plan, or with `format` to a plain-text ASCII plan ("txt"), Plan JSON ("json") or an image ("png"). Format "json" returns the plan as an object, with `schema` naming its JSON Schema; passed back as `plan_json` it compiles to the same drawing, unless the plan uses a part of the language Plan JSON does not carry (the sheet, styles, curves, roofs, storeys, `place`, accessibility metadata). Returns the output plus diagnostics; a diagnostic usually carries a byte span with line/col and an E_/W_ code, and often a fix, sometimes one the `fix` tool can apply. Errors come back as data, never as exceptions: read `diagnostics` and correct the source. A multi-storey plan (`level <n> { … }`) returns the lowest storey in `output` and every storey in `pages[]` ({ level, name, output }); pass `level` to render just one. format "png" returns the usual result as text, then the drawing (the lowest storey, or `level`) as image content, as wide as `width` says; it needs the optional renderer @resvg/resvg-js, and without it the call returns ok:false with an error saying how to install it.

format.description: svg (default), txt (zero-dependency ASCII), json (Plan JSON, the shape `plan_json` takes) or png (an image; needs the optional renderer).

level.description: Render only this storey of a multi-storey plan. An undeclared level is an error, not a guess.

overlay.description: Draw an opt-in circulation overlay (SVG only).

plan_json.description: Plan JSON (RPLAN shape) as an alternative to `source`; converted to .arch then compiled.

source.description: ArchLang source (a `plan "…" { … }`). Provide this OR plan_json.

width.description: png only (any other format refuses it): the image width in pixels, clamped to 256-4096, and narrower for a tall plan so neither side exceeds 4096; default 1600.

name: compile
title: Compile ArchLang → SVG, ASCII, Plan JSON or PNG
